title: Credential
description: A credential the hub mints, as the hub stores it (contract 03, C-03.5 to C-03.17). One variant per kind. Secrets are never stored or shown here: a record holds only the sha256 of its secret, found by hash as web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/domain/writers.js keyOf finds daemon-local credentials. The daemon-local credentials (Claude's writer token, a service child's token, a driver's lease) are not hub credentials and have no variant here.

id26.description: The 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters of a hub id.

time_or_null.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, or null when the event has not happened.

account_ref.description: The account a credential is bound to: a user or a service user.

id.description: The account id (usr_ for a user, svc_ for a service user; svc_home is Home).

secret_hash.description: The sha256 of the secret as presented on the wire, lowercase hex. The secret itself is never stored.

revocation.description: Why and by whom a credential was revoked; null while it is live.

by.description: The Activity entry that records the revocation.

user_session.description: The per-user session the shell and the phone app use, minted after a sign-in whose identity the allowlist admits: an OIDC sign-in, or an OAuth 2.0 sign-in whose subject comes from the provider's user API (C-03.6, C-03.6a, C-03.6b; amendment A-03.1). Wire form: cookie __Host-swc_s on the hub apex, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/.

client.description: Which client holds it; sets the lifetimes (shell 24 h idle and 7 d absolute, phone 7 d idle and 30 d absolute).

idp.description: The identity the session was minted from, the pair (issuer, subject) the account is bound to (C-03.6a). An OIDC identity and an OAuth 2.0 identity have the same shape.

issuer.description: The issuer: for OIDC the id_token's iss URL (https://accounts.google.com for Google); for an OAuth 2.0 provider the fixed issuer C-03.6b names (https://github.com for GitHub).

subject.description: The subject at that issuer: for OIDC the id_token's sub; for GitHub the decimal string of the numeric id from GET https://api.github.com/user, never the login (C-03.6b).
A GitHub subject is the numeric user id in decimal (C-03.6b).

auth_epoch.description: The hub auth epoch at minting (C-03.30); an older epoch than the hub's ends the session.

idle_expires_at.description: Moves forward on use, never past expires_at.

device.description: The device registration this session is bound to (phone), or null.

surface_ticket.description: A single-use ticket that admits a user session to one chat's origin (C-03.10). Carried once as the t query parameter of https://chat-<label>.<hub>/__swc/enter and consumed by the hub.

chat.description: The chat whose origin it admits.

origin.description: session for chat-<label>.<hub>, answer for chat-<label>-a.<hub>.

surface_session.description: A user's session on one chat origin (C-03.10). Wire form: cookie __Host-swc_srf on that chat's host (or its answer host), HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/. Never outlives its parent user session.

ticket.description: The ticket it was entered with.

expires_at.description: No later than the parent's expires_at.

api_key.description: A Komodo-style API key (C-03.7, inputs/komodo-template.md Permissions): key id plus secret, the secret shown once at creation, bound to one account. Wire form: X-Api-Key: key_<id> and X-Api-Secret: sws_<43 base64url characters>. Authenticates the hub API only; a chat origin and a daemon refuse it.

owner.description: The account the key acts as.

name.description: A label the creator gave it.

created_by.description: Who minted it: a user id, or hub for keys the hub's supervisor mints (Home's, C-03.16).

expires_at.description: When it stops working. Required for a user's key (at most 365 days after created_at); null (never) is allowed only for a service user's key.

secret_prefix.description: The first 8 characters of the secret after sws_, shown in the UI to tell keys apart.

scope.description: An optional narrowing of what the key may reach; its meaning is contract 04's. Absent means the owner's full rights.

machine.description: The machine credential registered by pairing (contract 05 owns the handshake and the key algorithm). What it asserts is fixed by C-03.8: this connection speaks for this machine, paired by this user; it never asserts any user.

key_id.description: The current key's id (section 2, Machine key id): `mky_` plus 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters (alphabet 0123456789abcdefghjkmnpqrstvwxyz) encoding the first 130 bits, most significant bit first, of SHA-256 over the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, no padding. Derived, so both sides name a key before the hub has registered it (05 C-05.7). Test vector in section 2.

public_key.description: The machine's public key as pairing registered it. The private key never leaves the machine.

alg.description: Key algorithm; v1 proposes ed25519, contract 05 fixes it.

value.description: The wire form of the key (C-03.8): the raw 32 bytes, base64url without padding, 43 characters. The only encoding of the key on the wire (05) and in the connector record (06).

fingerprint.description: The display form of the key (C-03.8): `SHA256:` and the unpadded base64 of SHA-256 over the raw public key, the OpenSSH form, 43 characters after the prefix. Shown in Settings and Machines; the same string the connector prints at pairing and in `connect status` (05 C-05.2, 06 C-06.8).

paired_by.description: The user who entered the pairing code.

asserts.description: The rights the credential carries (C-03.8), closed list.

connector_session.description: One authenticated connector WebSocket (C-03.9). Relay streams opened in it end with it.

machine.description: The machine whose credential opened it.

expires_at.description: At most 24 h after opened_at; the connector then handshakes again.

connector_version.description: The connector's version as it reported it in the handshake (05).

close_reason.description: Why it closed, when it has.

agent_token.description: A token for one Claude Code session's calls to the hub API (C-03.12). Defined so contract 10 can name it; issued only when 10 calls for it. Delivered over the connector, never written to a project directory.

chat.description: The chat the agent belongs to.

agent_session.description: The Claude Code session id, cc:<uuid>.

expires_at.description: At most 12 h after issued_at; the connector renews it.

device.description: A device registration for Web Push (C-03.17). Binds one push subscription to one user; grants nothing. The endpoint is stored encrypted at rest; this record exposes only its push service origin and hash.

registered_by.description: The user session that registered it.

label.description: A name for it in Settings (from the user or the user agent).

push.description: The subscription, as far as this record shows it.

service_origin.description: The push service's origin, for example https://web.push.apple.com.

endpoint_hash.description: sha256 of the endpoint URL, lowercase hex.
